requirementResults.reason: The assistant falsely implies that there are rental listings available to view ('Are you ready to see a couple of places...'), which violates the requirement to not claim current availability or live rental status when no rental records exist.
The assistant successfully captured the rental intent without converting the user into a buyer flow, as confirmed by the deterministic observations.
